note: Independent rejudgment 2026-11-22 after Router Key (type 9) handling was added to RTRSession.handlePDU. RFC 6810 Section 5.1 requires: 'Zero: Fields shown as zero or reserved MUST be zero. The value of such a field MUST be ignored on receipt.' Its PDU version is 0. Current handlePDU still rejects initial version-0 data PDUs (rtrVersionMin=1), refuses downgrade to version 0 in its code-4 branch, and syncOnce never retries below version 1. Adding pduRouterKey handling in handlePDU does not lower the supported version floor or establish a version-0 session. No test carries this id; the row remains an owed version-0 implementation gap.
